text_block_list.text: Oh, just one of my favorite hand creams.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
It's not particularly popular, but I
haven't been
able to get another since it
went out of stock last
week.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I recommended the same product to a
darling
pony last week. I wonder if she
managed to buy
one.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
choice_data_list: Maybe it's sold out because you recommended it to her.

text_block_list.text:
But indeed, that was why. All of Fuji
Kiseki's fans
rushed to buy the same
hand cream, leaving her
hands dry and
flaky for a while.
